15.text: But Jesus answering said to him, 'Suffer now, for thus it is becoming to us to fulfil all righteousness,' then he doth suffer him.

4.text: But he answering said, 'It hath been written, Not upon bread alone doth man live, but upon every word coming forth from the mouth of God.'

7.text: Jesus said to him again, 'It hath been written, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.'

10.text: Then saith Jesus to him, 'Go — Adversary, for it hath been written, The Lord thy God thou shalt bow to, and Him only thou shalt serve.'

17.text: From that time began Jesus to proclaim and to say, 'Reform ye, for come nigh hath the reign of the heavens.'
